🇲🇽🌎 <u>"Never let those from the north denigrate you"</u>

Argentine sociologist Alexandre Roig (UNSAM) told Contralínea that Mexico is not immune to the far right: "I remember the Brazilians who laughed at Bolsonaro and the Argentines who laughed at Milei." In his view, the far right advances wherever progressives settle for managing the neoliberal institutions they inherited. Mexico's defense is its people and its habit of debating and transforming its institutions: "The best way to counter the rise of the far right is to be aware and never let yourself be denigrated by those who come from outside, above all if they come from the north."

🇲🇽🗳️ <u>Taddei: "This presidency has no favorite companies"</u>

After President Sheinbaum asked INE to clear up suspect contracts for electoral materials, INE president Guadalupe Taddei says she will ask the Federal Audit Office (ASF) to review the institute's tenders. Her defense is that some of the firms named have supplied INE since 2019, so no one should "attribute to a person a decision made even before her arrival at this institution." She sent the officials' files to INE's internal comptroller to check their asset and conflict-of-interest filings. FGR, SAT and UIF are already investigating former INE officials and contractors for embezzlement and money laundering.
banner: INE CONTRACTS: TADDEI CALLS IN AUDITORS

text:
🔥🇲🇽 <u>IMSS workers throw the PAN out of their protest</u>

PAN national leader Jorge Romero went to the IMSS workers' encampment on Reforma to back their demands and call for director Zoé Robledo to resign. The workers answered with "Out with the PAN!" and "Opportunists!", reminded him that his party helped dismantle their retirement system, and pushed the delegation out. Sheinbaum called it "the most absurd and ridiculous political opportunism. People are not stupid."
banner: IMSS WORKERS TO THE PAN: GET OUT

text:
🇲🇽⚖️ <u>IMSS shuts the Modalidad 40 pension loophole</u>

"Through Modalidad 40, these fraudulent schemes were run to obtain a pension that did not correspond to the worker," President Sheinbaum said. She put the fraud at hundreds of billions of pesos. As of October 22, new registrations in IMSS's voluntary-contribution scheme must contribute on the last base salary on record plus at most one UMA, never below the minimum wage. The goal, in her words: "enough resources for real pensions, and no more frauds."

🇲🇽🏭 <u>Mexico keeps its tariff wall on Chinese cars</u>

Mexico's Economy Ministry says the tariffs on cars from countries with no trade deal with Mexico, China first among them, are staying. "These measures should be maintained as part of a broader industrial policy," Carlos Castillo, the ministry's head of productive development, told the AMDA auto forum (El Economista). Marcelo Ebrard says vehicle imports have dropped 70% under the tariffs: "there was indeed a very big disadvantage in the automotive industry."

🔥🇲🇽 <u>El Ocotal: 124 trees felled, again</u>

Residents of Loma del Padre and Indigenous collectives in Cuajimalpa, Mexico City, report that 124 trees were cut on Monday in the El Ocotal forest beside the México-Toluca federal highway. It is the second time this year. There was no prior consultation, and the cutting broke an agreement to remove only diseased or leaning trees. Neighbor Sugey Pérez says healthy trees were cut along with diseased ones. The SICT is working under a permit issued on December 10, 2024. About 400 hectares of the forest are registered to Sanborns, part of Carlos Slim's Grupo Carso, which bought land there in 1982.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>Sheinbaum: "Politics should not be judicialized"</u>

Sheinbaum declined to send the FGR after PRI leader Alito Moreno and PAN senator Lilly Téllez, who have both taken Mexican affairs to US authorities. "The people's judgment is enough for a politician who calls on a foreign government to intervene in Mexico." She contrasted them with former Chihuahua prosecutor César Jáuregui, who is accused of treason for allegedly letting US agents into an April operation in El Pinal. "Just as I say justice must not be politicized, politics must not be judicialized either."
banner: SHEINBAUM: VOTERS JUDGE ALITO, NOT THE FGR

text:
🔥🇲🇽 <u>PRI goes to court over a Dirty War spot</u>

Alito Moreno's PRI filed a complaint over a CNDH radio spot from the series "Los Años Heridos" that names the "state political violence of PRI governments": repression, censorship, spying, torture and forced disappearance during the Dirty War (1965-1990). INE refused to open a case, calling the content historical and informative. The PRI appealed, and the electoral tribunal (TEPJF) unanimously ordered INE to investigate. The ruling itself states it does not find that the CNDH broke any electoral rule.
banner: PRI SUES OVER DIRTY WAR SPOT

text:
🇲🇽⚖️ <u>Supreme Court revives Mahahual's case against Royal Caribbean</u>

Mexico's Supreme Court voted unanimously to reopen the amparo that residents of Mahahual, Quintana Roo, filed against rezoning 107.67 hectares for Royal Caribbean's "Perfect Day México" megaproject. A federal judge had thrown the case out as filed too late. Minister Lenia Batres' ruling found no proof that the residents missed the 30-day deadline and ordered the court to review the case again. The residents warn of environmental damage, no public consultation, and risks to drinking water and sewage treatment.
banner: MAHAHUAL VS ROYAL CARIBBEAN: CASE REVIVED

text:
🇲🇽🛢️ <u>Amigo LNG: "We will not commit an irresponsibility"</u>

A federal judge suspended the Amigo LNG export terminal in Guaymas, Sonora. President Sheinbaum has ordered a fresh review of every environmental impact before the government answers in court. Her figures: the plant takes up 0.05% of the Guaymas production zone and would add about 4% more vessels, on the same routes ships already use. "We are not going to commit the barbarity of harming the Gulf of California."
banner: AMIGO LNG: GULF OF CALIFORNIA FIRST
